mintAuthority.summary: USDso inherits frxUSD issuance, with a local role-gated token and collateral-taking BrandedCustodian. A 3-of-6 Safe controls token upgrades, factory upgrades and the custodian beacon; owner-only collateral recovery exists in code without an established current factory forwarding route. D14: The owner Safe can authorize a deposit-free local token minter; local issuance is economically unbounded.

Somnia guard storage response was empty 0x; no new zero-guard claim is made. Signer independence, operational key custody and executable fallback noninterference remain unestablished.

review.evidence: At somnia block 428274392, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 3,268,350.769507 frxUSD against 3,268,350.769507 USDso supply. The BrandedCustodian burns caller-owned USDso and returns frxUSD. At the pin, custodianTkn() was Somnia frxUSD 0x00000000d61733e7a393a10a5b48c311abe8f1e5; totalAssets(), brandedCoinMinted(), actual frxUSD custody and child supply matched. previewRedeem(1e18)=1e18, redeemFee()=0 and isolatedBackingEnabled()=false. The terms identify Frax Inc. and/or affiliates as issuer, disclaim Somnia fiat-redemption responsibility and exclude a holder yield entitlement. At Somnia block 428274392, custodian owner() returned BrandedFactory proxy 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d. Its owner field returned the same 3-of-6 Safe. The current BrandedCustodian code permits onlyOwner recoverERC20 of any token, including reserve frxUSD, and owner changes to caps, fees and isolated backing. No generic forwarding call for these functions was found in the current factory implementation, so direct Safe execution of the recovery function is not established. The Safe nevertheless owns both the factory ProxyAdmin (0xc1282f16dfb0ae563a93c40a406a583bd9a958a0) and custodian UpgradeableBeacon (0x251d07287c12707418a414b2c95436b4216b7bf4), enabling replacement of custody and issuance logic. Human independence and key custody remain unverified and are priced by their dedicated control signals; financial/legal safeguards remain Backing-domain gaps. Human independence and key custody are separately preserved disclosure gaps."]. Genuine unknown implementation, controller authorization and unreadable execution state are retained as umbrella questions; identified-signer custody/independence is recorded per control, not asserted to be independently scored or resolved. Field re-justification: reconciliation=continuous describes the cited local parent-token custody and wrap/custodian supply-accounting mechanism only. It does not certify the upstream fiat/Treasury book, independent assurance or holder insolvency priority; supervision=unknown supplies no prudential or attestation-based credit. D14/D29 sweep (2026-10-03): Verified GeniusDollar initialization grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the owner and sets MINTER_ROLE admin to FACTORY_ROLE. At Somnia block 428274392, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,0x9527e19f55d1afce9f1e9edcea79552bf41983f9)=true. AccessControl makes FACTORY_ROLE default-admin-controlled: the Safe can grant itself FACTORY_ROLE and then MINTER_ROLE. GeniusDollar.mint(account,value) then calls _mint without a deposit check. BrandedCustodian deposits do not constrain this separate authorization path; inherited frxUSD risk is not the trigger.
